tagging_basis: AQA 7037 specification codes; AS units mapped to the matching A-level leaf

units.summary: Outline the spatial organisation of one studied transnational corporation.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of familiar content; needs a named TNC but no data.

units.summary: Analyse a compound line graph and divided bar graph on UN peacekeeping forces.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of two quantitative graphs; no own knowledge required.

units.summary: Using a proportional map of Chinese exports and own knowledge, assess how important location is in trade between major and smaller economies.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1/AO2 short assess applying knowledge to a novel cartogram-style figure.

units.summary: Evaluate whether climate change and economic pressures make protecting global commons such as Antarctica harder.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark AO1/AO2 essay combining threats, governance and the commons concept; sustained judgement.

units.summary: Outline how topography can contribute to the character of a place.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a single factor; familiar content.

units.summary: Evaluate the usefulness of a 1906 poem and sketch and a 2014 aerial photograph for showing change in Ancoats.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 evaluation of unfamiliar qualitative sources of different type and date.

units.summary: Using a tweet and news report, judge whether place meaning depends on different perspectives.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1/AO2 short evaluation applying insider and outsider perspective knowledge to novel qualitative sources.

units.summary: With reference to a local place, assess how far qualitative and quantitative sources give contrasting images of it.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay requiring local place study knowledge and evaluation of source types.

units.summary: Outline the role of world cities in the global economy.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of familiar content; no data.

units.summary: Using a liveability ranking map and suburban aerial photograph, assess factors behind high liveability in cities.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item (AO1 4 AO2 5) applying knowledge to two novel figures.

units.summary: Using a studied river restoration project, assess its impact on urban drainage.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item needing a specific example and evaluation of outcomes.

units.summary: With two contrasting urban areas, assess how far strategies for managing economic inequality are unsuccessful.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay needing two contrasting urban places and evaluation of strategy success.

units.summary: Outline characteristics of an agricultural system.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of familiar systems content.

units.summary: Analyse population change in Cuba from two population pyramids and a table of vital rates.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of pyramids and rates, connecting graphical and numerical data.

units.summary: Assess the extent to which economic migrants help countries achieve a demographic dividend.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark AO1/AO2 extent item linking migration implications to the demographic dividend concept.

units.summary: Assess whether current population growth and climate change justify a Malthusian viewpoint.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay combining population perspectives and future projections; open-ended evaluation.

units.summary: Outline one strategy used to manage energy consumption.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of one strategy; familiar content.

units.summary: Assess how far the geopolitics of mineral ore trade is determined by global consumption patterns.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark AO1/AO2 extent item requiring evaluation of one determinant against others.

units.summary: Assess the relative importance of physical and human factors in causing water conflicts at different scales.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay requiring multi-scale examples and weighing of two factor groups.
